conditions.settingsMode: authenticated owner; Public profile; Appearance collapsed
conditions.cache: CDP Network.clearBrowserCache + CacheStorage/ServiceWorker/shader_cache per navigation; cookies and localStorage retained
conditions.extensions: separate temporary Chromium sessions launched with --disable-extensions; no extension targets or React DevTools hook
